item.title: 0.3.4-beta.6
item.description:
Fixed

  • Clicking a Live Activity could do nothing. Its card opens again, and a second click closes it.
  • Right-clicking the empty menu bar did nothing while a Live Activity showed. It opens Dimble's menu again.
  • Clicking the empty menu bar did nothing while a Live Activity showed. It shows your hidden icons, like it does the rest of the time.
  • Battery or Wi-Fi sat too close to the Live Activity beside them. They keep the same gap the pills keep from each other.
  • A Live Activity should no longer show twice for a few seconds after the bar shifts.

item.title: 0.3.4-beta.5
item.description:
New

  • Dimble has an accent color now, in Settings › General (#123, thanks @noahweidig). Pick one of six colors, or choose your own with a color wheel, a hex field or the eyedropper. It changes right away with no relaunch, and purple stays the default.
  • Wi-Fi can come back while your Mac is on a hotspot, so you can see when it's still on your phone after you get home (#121, thanks @brijazz). Pick "When it drops or on a hotspot" on its row in Settings › Menu Bar.
  • Battery can come back while it's charging, or below 30% or 40% (#126, thanks @querevs). There's also "While charging or below 20%", for both at once.

Fixed

  • A window taking focus while the panel took its icon pictures left a line under the tiles in row view and pushed icons up inside them (#127, thanks @jaylotw).
  • A tile could show a piece of the front app's menu in place of its icon, when the icon sat under those menus (#127, thanks @jaylotw).
  • Screen Mirroring's blue highlight no longer shows up as a square box on its tile (#125, thanks @qbosen). The icon takes your accent color instead while it's in use.
  • While a Live Activity shows, hovering or clicking the « shows your hidden icons only on the display under the pointer. It also showed them on your other displays.
  • Your hidden icons no longer flash for a frame when a Live Activity ends.
  • A Live Activity that had already ended could come back after a relaunch and stay on the bar for hours.
  • The Live Activities item no longer sits beside the pills it stands in for. It only shows without Screen Recording or with Show Live Activities off.
  • Settings › Menu Bar now names the Dimble items that keep Apple's Now Playing, camera controls, AirDrop, Focus and Timer hidden. It gave the wrong reason if you only had Quick Note, Shortcuts or Fast user switching on.
  • Dimble should no longer crash about 2 seconds after launch, while it reads the menu bar.
  • The Timer item should no longer stick at 0:00 after a Clock timer ends, which also held your next timer at 0:00.
  • The Camera & mic item should drop its SharePlay icon when Control Center restarts during a session.
  • A section's separators and Dimble items should no longer disappear until a relaunch over a long session.
  • The play/pause item should go back to play when nothing answered your click.

item.title: 0.3.4-beta.4
item.description:
Fixed

  • During a Live Activity, clicking an icon in the panel or the row opens that app's menu again. It opened the Live Activity's card instead.
  • Dimble's own icons in Hidden, like Shortcuts, now show with the rest of your hidden icons during a Live Activity. They didn't before.
  • When the clock is hidden, clicking its spot opens Notification Center right away, even while you record your screen (#103, thanks @TigerCat-hu). Once in a while it opened a second late, and your next click closed it.

Your icons stay in the order you gave them. Until now Dimble only kept each icon in its section. Now the layout editor is the order your bar keeps. When macOS or an app shifts an icon, Dimble puts it back on its own, about ten seconds later, the next time you pause. Updating rearranges nothing.

Each display can show hidden icons its own way. Your monitor can reveal in the menu bar while your MacBook uses the panel or a row. A display set to show all its icons now keeps them out wherever the pointer is (#88, thanks @wyaqoob).

Nine betas went into this one. There's also a Quick Note item, a Small Dot icon and Type to Siri, plus fixes for the clock and for full menu bars.

New

  • Icons stay in your order, not just in their section. macOS sometimes re-places a system icon like Wi-Fi or Battery, an app relaunches somewhere else, or a separator lands in a new spot. Dimble moves it back to where the layout editor shows it. It waits until the icon has sat out of place for about ten seconds and you've left the mouse and keyboard alone. The pointer hides for the moment it takes, and there's at most one pass every two minutes. After two tries on the same icon it stops, and what it couldn't put back still counts on the Apply button. It's part of "Keep sections grouped", on by default. defaults write app.fif7y.Pelmet pelmet.keepSectionsGrouped -bool false turns every automatic move off.
  • Each display gets its own "Show hidden icons in" in Settings › Displays, so it can use the menu bar, a panel or a row. Displays left on "Same as Panel tab" follow Settings › Panel (#88, thanks @wyaqoob). On a display that shows all its icons, it picks where a chevron click opens Always Hidden (#96, thanks @juanfcocontreras).
  • A Quick Note item, in Settings › Menu Bar (#99, thanks @dinopaulus). Apple's Quick Note icon is a Control Center control, and macOS takes those off the menu bar while Dimble hides your icons. Dimble's stays put, and a click starts a new Quick Note.
  • A Small Dot style for Dimble's icon, half the width of the Dot (#98, thanks @TigerCat-hu).

Changed

  • Clicking Dimble's Siri opens Type to Siri, like a click on Apple's own Siri icon, and a second click closes it. For voice, right-click it and pick "Talk to Siri" (#83, thanks @swhitlow).
  • In Settings › Menu Bar › Show when it matters, an icon that sits in Visible has a "Move to Hidden" link. It moves the icon and turns its rule on. Before, the switch was just greyed out (#92).
  • A ⌘-drag in the menu bar moves that one icon in the editor and leaves the rest where they are.
  • A new app's icon joins the editor where it showed up in the bar, under "New items" as before, instead of at the front.
  • Discard is gone from Settings › Menu Bar. A change you make in the editor goes in at your next pause, so to undo one, drag the icon back.

Fixed

  • A display set to show all its icons keeps showing them wherever the pointer is. Before, the pointer's display decided for every bar, so moving the pointer to your other display could hide them all (#88).
  • With the Clock hidden, clicking Control Center or the spot where the clock used to be no longer flashes your hidden icons on the bar. Those clicks go straight to Control Center now (#93, thanks @punchmac).
  • ⌥-click on the clock turns Do Not Disturb on and off again, with "Clicking the clock opens Notification Center" on or off (#92, thanks @juanfcocontreras).
  • On some Macs with macOS 27.2, clicking the clock opened Notification Center and closed it right away. Dimble now catches that within two clicks and opens it with a real click from then on (#94, thanks @chinming17).
  • After closing the lid with external displays attached and opening it again, the chevron could go missing until Dimble relaunched. Dimble now checks the bar when your Mac wakes or the displays change, and puts the chevron back if it's gone (#26, thanks @cpierce).
  • On a full menu bar, macOS could put Dimble's chevron behind its own « with the rest. Dimble now notices, and its own extras (camera, media, Siri…) step aside to make room, then come back once there's space. A reveal also holds while Apple's « is open on your hidden icons (#81, thanks @2f4vwwb5t6-gif).
  • The panel and the row show up on whichever Space you're on. If the panel's window gets stuck on one Space, Dimble notices when it opens and builds a new one (#100, thanks @wppqqppq).
  • Without Screen Recording, a display that shows all its icons opens its panel or row on the first chevron click. It used to widen the menu bar, and only the third click opened the panel (#96, thanks @juanfcocontreras).
  • An Always Hidden icon that slipped in among the Hidden ones goes back to its side. It used to stay there when it only showed during a reveal (#80, thanks @Erimus-Koo).
  • The Stop button of a screen recording (⇧⌘5) shows while Dimble hides your icons. It's in Visible, right of the chevron.
  • When one of your displays shows all its icons, the chevron on your other displays stays in sight. A new icon to its right, like Camera & Mic or the Stop button, used to hide it.
  • An icon could stay put when macOS refused the drag during Apply. The retry now lands it.
  • Applying a change in Settings › Menu Bar no longer leaves blank space right of the chevron while it moves your icons.

Also

  • With a display set to show all its icons, switching apps takes one picture of your other bars instead of two. A picture that's no longer needed is let go within a minute instead of a day.
  • In Settings › Menu Bar, the title row's hint truncates instead of pushing the buttons onto a second line.

Pelmet is now Dimble. Another macOS menu bar app had the name Pelmet first, so I decided to rename ours. It's the same app, and your settings, permissions and launch at login carry over. On its first launch after the update, the app renames itself to Dimble.app and opens again.

If anything looks off after the update, please tell me on GitHub.

The one you asked for most is here, your hidden icons in a panel under the menu bar. There's also a new Settings, icons that show up only when they matter, and every fix from eight betas.

The panel

Hidden icons can open as tiles in a glass panel under the menu bar, and a click on a tile opens that icon's real menu. Turn it on in Settings › Panel › "Show hidden icons in" and pick Panel, or Row for a single strip. Menu bar stays the default.

  • The tiles are pictures of your real icons. App icons stand in when Screen Recording isn't allowed. Apple's own items like Bluetooth or Focus show their own mark until they get a picture.
  • Open it with a click, a hover or the shortcut. Type to search, move with the arrows and Return, Esc to close. It closes when the pointer leaves, like the bar does.
  • It opens on the display you click or hover, right under that display's bar.
  • Drag a tile to reorder it, to another section, or up onto the menu bar to show it there. ⌘-drag an icon from the menu bar onto the panel to hide it.
  • Always Hidden sits behind a fold you click. A "Didn't fit" section lists the icons macOS had no room for in the bar.
  • Right-click a tile for Open Menu, Show in Menu Bar (just that icon, and it goes back after), Move to…, Alias and Shortcut… and Quit.
  • Drag the panel's left edge for more or fewer columns, double-click it for Auto. Names can be shown too.

Thanks @elijah7x for asking for it (#26), and @cpierce, @OiCkilL and @2f4vwwb5t6-gif for testing it through the betas.

New

  • Settings got a full redesign. Menu Bar now holds everything about your icons, and a click on any tile there opens its options. General has every shortcut in one place, and permissions you've already granted fold into one quiet line. Apply only shows up when there's something to apply.
  • Show when it matters, for icons you keep hidden (#86, thanks @pzelnip). Battery shows while you're on battery or below 20%, Wi-Fi when it isn't connected, Focus while a Focus is on and Time Machine while a backup runs. Turn each one on in Settings › Menu Bar.
  • Icons stay in their section. macOS sometimes drops a hidden icon right of the chevron, after a ⌘-drag or when an app relaunches into a crowded bar. Dimble moves it back on its own once you leave the mouse and keyboard alone for a couple of seconds. This needs Dimble's icon in the menu bar (#80, thanks @Erimus-Koo).
  • An icon you drop into Hidden or Always Hidden in Settings crosses the arrow on its own a few seconds later, no Apply needed.
  • Shortcuts can be turned off. Hover one in Settings and click the ×, or press ⌫ while recording, so another app can have the combo. ↺ brings the default back (#79, thanks @gasparschott).
  • Media controls comes and goes while something plays, like Camera & mic, with a While playing or Always choice. Sounds under 5 seconds don't count, so a screenshot shutter doesn't bring it out.
  • Search has its own tab in Settings, with a command bar to try it in and your aliases and shortcuts. Alias and Shortcut… on any icon opens it with that icon ready.
  • The right-click menu on Dimble's icon leads with Search and Settings, and shows the shortcuts for Hide Items and Show Always Hidden Too.
  • Release notes show up in the update window, and About has a "What's new in this version" link.

Changed

  • Pelmet is now Dimble. On its first launch after the update, the app renames itself from Pelmet.app (or Pliss.app if you ran 0.3.2-beta.7) to Dimble.app and opens again.
  • The app icon is a D now, same dots.
  • Logs are now in ~/Library/Logs/Dimble/dimble.log, and your old logs move there too.
  • The website is dimble.fif7y.com and the repo is github.com/fif7y/dimble. Old links keep working.
  • If you installed with Homebrew, the cask is dimble now. Once the app has updated itself, quit it, run brew reinstall --cask --force fif7y/tap/dimble once, and open Dimble again.

Fixed

  • A double-click on the chevron reveals Always Hidden too, like the settings say. It only worked in empty menu bar space, and on the chevron the second click shut the bar again (#77, thanks @kaypeter87).
  • ⌥-click on the chevron reveals Always Hidden on macOS 27 too. macOS 27 wasn't saying the ⌥ key was down, so it acted like a plain click.
  • Clicking the clock opens Notification Center again on macOS 27.2, where it flashed open and closed right away. It also opens on Macs where the app thought it was already open (#81, thanks @2f4vwwb5t6-gif). A second ⌥⌘N closes it for good.
  • Hover reveal works on the first visit after you hide icons with the shortcut or from a menu. The hover zone also ends at the chevron as it's drawn (#84, thanks @swhitlow).
  • Icons that come from a helper app take the app's name. Fantastical showed up as 85C27NK92C… (#81, thanks @2f4vwwb5t6-gif).
  • An icon you move to Visible crosses the arrow on its own on a bar with none of Dimble's own icons on it. It used to wait for them forever (#81, thanks @2f4vwwb5t6-gif).
  • Reordering inside Hidden or Always Hidden applies. When two moves would do, Apply moves the icon you dropped and not its neighbour.
  • An icon you ⌘-drag stays where you dropped it, past one of Dimble's own icons or on another display's bar.
  • Clicks open menus again after an Apply. The app could leave ⌘ held after its last drag.
  • Hidden icons hide again on their own after the app starts with the screen locked. The media control gets placed again after a track change on a locked screen.

Also

  • The Apply button goes grey once the menu bar matches your settings. The "Your menu bar is full" note is now "N behind «" at the top of the Menu Bar pane, and only shows while the bar stays full.
  • A locked Mac no longer reads the menu bar every 2 seconds all night.
